title: Grateful Dead Live at Autzen Stadium, U. of Oregon on 1990-06-24
lineage: Cassette Master -> Nakamichi Cassette Deck 1.5 > DBX 224X-DS Noise Reduction System > Sound Devices 722
taper: Recorded and transfered by Allen Ryals  (billtmcdee) Patched and Pitched by Jason Chastain Mastered by Jamie Waddell Tracked and Flac'd by Norm Bowen
source: Master Audience Recording Audio Technica 815a Mics > Marantz PMD430 Recorder, DBX on > Maxell XLII-S cassette

ai_review.summary: Good audience recording with clear mids and highs, though the bass response is a bit thin
ai_review.review: The audience (Aud) source captures the marathon concert with respectable clarity; mids and highs are notably crisp while the low end lacks some depth compared to other sources. Reviewers rate it positively overall, making it a solid go‑to tape for listeners who prioritize detail over bass heft.

ai_rating.rationale: Only one review available; the reviewer gave 4 stars and praised clarity, but provided no musical performance details, so rating is based mainly on recording quality.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear mids and highs, respectable overall sound; bass response not as deep as the Brotman Schps source but still usable.
